items.title: On quantum interactive proofs with a laconic prover
items.summary: Interactive proof systems with a laconic prover, studied by Goldreich, Vadhan, and Wigderson (CC, 2002), capture problems verifiable with logarithmic prover communication in the classical setting. For two-message quantum analogs, even a single-bit prover response contains quantum statistical zero-knowledge ($\sf QSZK$), introduced by Watrous (FOCS 2002). However, restricting the verifier's question to classical public coins collapses the corresponding class to $\sf BQP$, as shown by Beigi, Shor, and Watrous (ToC, 2011). We further study two-message quantum interactive proof systems with a laconic prover. To this end, we introduce the class ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, where $\ell$ is the length of the prover's response, and establish: 1. A natural complete characterization of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ by Multi-State Distinguishability. In particular, Quantum State Distinguishability (QSD) is ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$-complete. Since QSD is $\sf QSZK$-hard, our result places ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$, for $\ell\geq 2$, in a landscape "just above" $\sf QSZK$. 2. Easy regimes for ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ collapsing to $\sf QSZK$. We prove that QSD$[a,b]$ (and thus ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}[a,b]$) is in $\sf QSZK$ when $a(n)-b(n)\geq 1/O(\log n)$, and combine this with an answer compression from ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}[2,c,s]$ to ${\sf QIP}_{\rm bit}$ to obtain another easy regime when $2c>(1+2^{\ell/2})s$. Remarkably, our improved polarization applies to SD and $\sf SZK$, resolving an open problem in Sahai and Vadhan (JACM, 2003). 3. Quantum public coins also make the interaction useless: ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[O(\sqrt{\log{n}})]$ with constant gap is in $\sf BQP$, where ${\sf qc}\text{-}{\sf QAM}[\ell]$ is a subclass of ${\sf QIP}_{\ell\text{-}{\rm bit}}(2)$ in which the verifier's question is exactly halves of EPR pairs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究带简洁证明者（laconic prover）的两消息量子交互证明系统。经典情形下，Goldreich、Vadhan 与 Wigderson 于 2002 年提出的简洁证明者交互证明，刻画了证明者通信量仅为对数级即可验证的问题类。量子两消息对应物的一个极端例子是：即便证明者只回复 1 个比特，其类别也已包含 Watrous（FOCS 2002）引入的量子统计零知识 QSZK；但 Beigi、Shor 与 Watrous（ToC 2011）指出，若把验证者的提问限制为经典公共硬币，该类会塌缩到 BQP。本文引入 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 类，其中 ℓ 是证明者回复的比特长度，并给出三项结果：其一，用多态可区分性（Multi-State Distinguishability）给出 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 的自然完全刻画，特别地量子态可区分性 QSD 是 QIP_bit-完全的；由于 QSD 是 QSZK-难的，因此 ℓ≥2 的 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 处于“刚好高于”QSZK 的位置。其二，证明若干易退化区间会塌缩到 QSZK：当 a(n)-b(n) ≥ 1/O(log n) 时 QSD[a,b]（从而 QIP_bit[a,b]）属于 QSZK；并将 QIP_{ℓ-bit}[2,c,s] 的答案压缩到 QIP_bit，得到 2c > (1+2^{ℓ/2})s 时的另一易区间；其改进的极化（polarization）技术同时适用于 SD 与 SZK，解决了 Sahai 与 Vadhan（JACM 2003）留下的公开问题。其三，证明量子公共硬币同样使交互失效：常数间隙下的 qc-QAM[O(√log n)] 属于 BQP，其中 qc-QAM[ℓ] 是 QIP_{ℓ-bit}(2) 的子类，验证者的问题恰为 EPR 对的一半。论文适合量子复杂度理论、量子零知识与后量子密码基础研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果刻画了量子交互协议中“验证者提问结构 + 证明者回复长度”对可达计算能力的上界：一旦引入量子公共硬币，交互可能塌缩到 BQP，说明部分看似强大的量子交互结构并不提供额外密码学能力。厘清 QSZK 与 QSD 的边界，有助于评估依赖量子零知识的协议假设是否稳健，也为后量子安全归约的适用范围划界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 属于量子复杂度与量子密码基础理论：影响基于 QSZK/SZK 的零知识协议安全假设分析、极化引理在统计距离与量子态可区分性中的适用范围，以及对量子公共硬币模型能力的判断；不涉及具体实现、部署或已知攻击。
defense_advice_zh: 该工作为复杂度理论结果，无直接工程可落地项；建议纳入量子密码学假设评估的文献跟踪清单，并在评审量子零知识协议方案时参考其关于公共硬币与交互塌缩的结论。

items.title: jackson-dataformats-binary: Smile parser does not enforce StreamReadConstraints.maxNameLength, enabling memory-exhaustion denial of service
items.summary: The Smile parser in FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary never invokes StreamReadConstraints.validateNameLength() when decoding JSON object property names, so the maxNameLength limit is not enforced for this format. SmileParser._handleLongFieldName() grows its internal name buffer through an unconstrained _growArrayTo() call and performs no length validation. An attacker who can have a Smile document parsed may therefore embed a single property name of unbounded length; the parser buffers the whole name in memory before returning it, whatever maxNameLength is configured to. Because StreamReadConstraints.maxDocumentLength is also disabled by default, nothing else bounds the name under default settings, so the only limits are the attacker's upload capacity and available heap, leading to memory exhaustion and denial of service. No privileges beyond the ability to submit data to a parsing endpoint are required, and exploitation needs only that the bytes reach SmileFactory parsing, directly or through an ObjectMapper configured with the Smile module. jackson-core's own JSON parsers enforce maxNameLength incrementally during name decoding; this gap is specific to the binary formats. maxNameLength and validateNameLength were introduced in jackson-core 2.16.0, so releases before 2.16.0 do not contain the constraint that is left unenforced. This issue is tracked together with the CBOR parser defect in the same vendor advisory, GHSA-3v8f-v6vx-fmrm, which covers both binary formats. The Smile parser defect (jackson-dataformats-binary issue #726) is CVE-2026-68496; the CBOR parser defect (issue #725) is assigned CVE-2026-68495.

items.title: Classroom 50 vulnerable to arbitrary file overwrite on the teacher's machine via symlink in a student repo (gh teacher download)
items.summary: Classroom 50 is a free and open-source tool for managing and grading programming assignments via GitHub. Prior to version 1.11.0, `gh teacher download` clones each student's assignment repository and then writes autograde artifacts (`result.json` and `results.json`) into the just-cloned working tree. The write followed symlinks, so a student who committed `result.json` or `results.json` as a **symlink** (materialized verbatim by `git clone`) could redirect the teacher's write to an arbitrary path — e.g. `~/.zshrc`, `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, a cron file, or an in-clone `.git/hooks/*` file that git subsequently executes. The written bytes are attacker-controlled (the student's uploaded release asset for `result.json`; student-chosen submit-tag names for `results.json`). This is an arbitrary file write leading to code execution as the teacher, whose `gh` token carries `admin:org`, `repo`, and `workflow` across the entire classroom organization. Version 1.11.0 contains a patch. Some workarounds are available. Avoid running `gh teacher download` against untrusted student repositories, or run it inside a disposable sandbox / container with no access to sensitive host files or credentials. Inspect cloned trees for symlinked, hardlinked, or special (`result.json`/`results.json`) entries before allowing the artifact-refresh step to run.

items.title: Apache Camel Quarkus: Camel Quarkus: Forced Xalan TransformerFactory drops upstream external-DTD/stylesheet hardening
items.summary:
Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference in the XSLT support extension (camel-quarkus-support-xalan) in Apache Camel Quarkus from 3.2.0 before 3.33.3 and from 3.34.0 before 3.40.0 on all platforms allows an attacker who supplies the XML document being transformed to read local files or issue requests to internal network locations via an external entity declaration in that document.

The extension supplies its own Xalan-backed TransformerFactory to the xslt component and registers it as the JAXP default. Xalan-J 2.7.x predates JAXP 1.5 and does not honour javax.xml.XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD or ACCESS_EXTERNAL_STYLESHEET, so the external access restrictions Apache Camel applies to the TransformerFactory it creates were not in effect. On the xslt component path this affects message bodies that reach the transformer already as a javax.xml.transform.Source; bodies of other types are converted to a SAXSource by Apache Camel with external entities and external DTD loading disabled, and are not affected. Because the factory is also the JAXP default, other code in the application obtaining one through TransformerFactory.newInstance() loses the same restrictions without error.

Applications are affected if they use any of camel-quarkus-xslt, camel-quarkus-xslt-saxon, camel-quarkus-tika or camel-quarkus-xmlsecurity, each of which brings the XSLT support extension onto the classpath. For all but camel-quarkus-xslt, the exposure is limited to the JAXP default factory, since those extensions do not perform XSLT transformations themselves.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.33.3 or 3.40.0, which fixes this issue.

items.title: Super Forms <= 6.3.316 - Authenticated (Subscriber+) Arbitrary File/Directory Deletion via 'subdir' / 'path' Parameter
items.summary: The Super Forms – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File/Directory Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.316. This is due to the `super_save_form` AJAX handler performing no capability check — allowing Subscriber-level authenticated users to create or modify Super Forms and enable the `file_upload_submission_delete` setting — combined with the `super_submit_form` handler's `submit_form` function passing the attacker-controlled `files[].subdir` value from `$_POST['data']` directly into `SUPER_Common::delete_dir()` without sanitization, and a trivially bypassed `ABSPATH` guard that a `subdir` value of `wp-config.php` defeats because `dirname(realpath(ABSPATH . $subdir))` resolves to the WordPress root while the naive `ABSPATH !== $dir` string check fails to match due to a trailing-slash mismatch. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to recursively delete arbitrary files and directories on the server, up to and including the entire WordPress installation, resulting in full site takedown and potential remote code execution if critical files such as `wp-config.php` are removed and the site is subsequently re-installed by another party.

items.title: Super Forms <= 6.3.316 - Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation via 'role' Parameter
items.summary: The Super Forms – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.316. This is due to the Register & Login add-on's before_email_success_msg() function whitelisting the client-submitted 'role' key and copying it into the user-data array that is passed directly to wp_insert_user(), without validating the submitted role against the administrator-configured register_user_role, without an allow-list, and without any current_user_can() capability check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new account with the Administrator role by injecting role=administrator into the data submitted to any published Super Forms registration form (register_login_action='register').

items.title: pypdf: Possible large memory usage for large /ToUnicode streams (Follow-up 2)
items.summary: pypdf is a free and open-source pure-python PDF library. Prior to 6.18.1, a crafted PDF can place unusually large source-code or destination-string tokens in a font /ToUnicode mapping, causing pypdf/_cmap.py parse_bfchar to decode and retain oversized values during operations such as text extraction and consume excessive memory. This is a second follow-up to earlier /ToUnicode resource-consumption fixes and is limited to the remaining token-length path. This issue is fixed in version 6.18.1.

items.title: The Newsletter – Send awesome emails from WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insufficiently Protected Credentials in all versions up to, and including, 9.3.9 The pl...
items.summary: The Newsletter – Send awesome emails from WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insufficiently Protected Credentials in all versions up to, and including, 9.3.9 The plugin's public click-tracking REST route `/tnp/l/` is registered with `permission_callback => '__return_true'` and, upon receiving a valid keyed-MD5 signature, calls `set_user_cookie()`, which emits a `Set-Cookie: newsletter=<id>-<raw_token>` response header to the requester because the subscriber object loaded via `get_user()` lacks the `_trusted` property, causing `get_user_key()` to return the raw token column value instead of its MD5-masked variant. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers who obtain any signed click-tracking URL for a target subscriber to receive that subscriber's permanent raw authentication cookie, which they can then use to export the subscriber's full PII record via the JSON profile-export endpoint (`?na=px`), rewrite the subscriber's stored profile (`?na=ps`), and silently unsubscribe the subscriber via the RFC-8058 one-click endpoint (`?na=ocu`), none of which require a nonce, password, or email challenge. Signed tracking URLs are embedded in every external link of every newsletter delivered to a subscriber, carry no timestamp, and never expire until the site's relink key rotates, meaning that any party who observes such a URL — through a forwarded email, a shared inbox, a mail-gateway log, or Referer headers on the redirect target, which has no Referrer-Policy set — can replay it indefinitely to obtain the victim's credential.

items.title: Compatibility Test Suite (CTS)

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条目来自 Android 官方安全公告站点中的“Compatibility Test Suite (CTS)”文档页面，时间为 2026-10-02。需要首先明确：该页面是 Google 面向设备厂商（OEM/ODM）发布的兼容性测试框架说明文档，并不是一份漏洞公告，输入中也未提供任何 CVE 编号、受影响组件版本、漏洞成因、触发方式、攻击向量或修复补丁信息，因此不能将其解读为某个具体的安全漏洞。CTS（Compatibility Test Suite）是 Android 兼容性计划的核心组成部分，基于自动化测试（Trade Federation / Tradefed 测试框架）对设备的 API 行为、系统组件、图形与媒体处理、传感器、权限模型以及各类安全特性进行一致性校验，用于验证设备实现是否符合 Android 兼容性定义文档（CDD）及相关要求。厂商通常需要在产品出货前运行 CTS（并配合 GTS、VTS 等其他测试套件）并通过，才能获得 Google 移动服务（GMS）授权与相应认证。对防守方而言，理解 CTS 的价值在于：它是 Android 生态中“基线一致性”的把关机制，其中与安全相关的测试项（如权限、加密、KeyStore、SELinux 策略等）能间接反映设备的加固水平与合规状态。但本条目本身不构成可操作的安全风险，没有可修复的漏洞，也没有可检出的攻击行为；它更适合作为生态与合规背景知识归档。若需跟进真实风险，应关注同一来源下定期发布的 Android 月度安全公告（含 CVE 与安全补丁级别）及 Google 官方公告渠道。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: CTS 是 Android 设备获得 GMS 认证的强制性一致性门槛，理解它有助于防守方把握 Android 生态的基线安全与合规要求；但本条为文档页面，无漏洞、无 CVE、无可操作风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 本条无需修复动作。建议将 CTS 作为 Android 合规与基线知识归档，关注 Android 官方月度安全公告以获取真正含 CVE 与补丁级别的漏洞信息；对存量 Android 资产，定期核查安全补丁级别与厂商 OTA 更新状态。

items.title: Compatibility Definition Document (CDD)

items.title: Background Security Improvements

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本次情报来自 Apple 官方安全发布渠道（Apple Security Releases）名为 “Background Security Improvements”（背景安全改进）的页面，标注发布时间为 2026-10-02。该页面属于 Apple 用于集中说明其快速安全修复机制的官方文档入口：Apple 会通过“背景安全改进”机制，在不要求用户安装完整系统大版本更新的前提下，向已发布的操作系统推送针对浏览器组件（如 Safari / WebKit）及其他系统组件的小型增量安全修复包，符合条件的设备在开启自动更新时会自动接收并生效。与常规的 Apple 安全更新公告不同，此类页面通常以说明性、汇总性内容为主，往往不逐条列出 CVE 编号、受影响的具体产品型号与系统版本，也不提供统一的严重性评级或漏洞技术细节。本次输入中未提供公告正文摘要，cves 字段为空，vendors 仅标注为 Apple Security Releases，products 未提供，severity 为 unknown，references 为空。因此当前无法判断该条目具体修复了哪些缺陷、漏洞成因是什么、攻击者需要何种条件才能触发、以及可能造成哪些实际影响，也无法确认是否涉及已被在野利用的问题。对防守方可确认的事实仅为：Apple 于该时间点在其官方安全渠道发布了与背景安全改进相关的说明内容，需进一步访问源链接或等待后续完整公告（CVE 列表、受影响产品与版本、厂商严重性评级）补充后，才能开展风险定级与补丁优先级排序。

llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 保持 Apple 设备自动更新与背景安全改进功能开启，避免因禁用自动更新而长期缺失快速修复；2) 在企业终端管理（MDM）策略中确认允许接收此类增量安全修复，避免策略误拦；3) 通过资产台账盘点在网 Apple 设备型号与系统版本，为后续公告明确受影响范围时快速定位做准备；4) 打开源链接并订阅 Apple 官方安全发布渠道，待 CVE 列表与厂商评级发布后重新评估并排定补丁优先级；5) 在信息不足期间，对浏览器及 Web 内容渲染相关风险保持常规监测与日志留存，不轻信非官方转述。

items.title: The DevKit Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass Leading to Administrator Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.0 This is due to t...
items.summary: The DevKit Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass Leading to Administrator Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.0 This is due to the `revert_switch` handler trusting the attacker-controlled `original_user_id` cookie as the privileged identity: `verify_nonce_and_capability()` incorrectly checks the `manage_options` capability on the user identified by the cookie rather than on the actual requester via `current_user_can()`, while the switch-back form and a valid session-bound nonce are emitted publicly via `wp_footer` to any visitor — including unauthenticated users — whenever that cookie is present. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to set the `original_user_id` cookie to any administrator's user ID, collect the rendered nonce, and POST it back to the `revert_switch` handler, causing `wp_set_auth_cookie()` to be called with the administrator's ID and granting the attacker a full administrator-level authenticated session and complete site takeover.

llm_summary.summary_zh: DevKit Pro 是 WordPress 的一款第三方插件，CVE-2026-14378 影响其 2.3.0 及之前的所有版本，问题类型为认证绕过（Authentication Bypass），最终可导致管理员账户接管。漏洞根因在于插件的 revert_switch（身份回切）处理逻辑对调用者身份的判定存在根本性缺陷：负责校验的函数 verify_nonce_and_capability() 没有使用 current_user_can() 对当前实际发起请求的用户做权限判断，而是把请求中由客户端可控的 original_user_id Cookie 所指向的用户当作特权身份，并对该身份校验 manage_options 能力。与此同时，回切表单以及与会话绑定的有效 nonce 会通过 wp_footer 钩子被公开渲染给任何访问者——只要请求携带该 Cookie，未认证用户同样能获取该表单与 nonce。两处缺陷叠加后，攻击者无需任何有效账号即可完成身份伪造，使 wp_set_auth_cookie() 以目标管理员的用户 ID 签发认证 Cookie，从而获得完整的站点管理员级已认证会话，实现站点完全接管。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H，基础分 9.8，属严重（Critical）级别；输入数据中 EPSS 无数据，未列入 CISA KEV，也未标注在野利用。修复方向应是在回切流程中严格以服务器端会话身份为准，使用 current_user_can() 校验真实请求者权限，并避免向未授权页面输出带回切能力的表单与 nonce。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证攻击者一旦得手即可直接取得 WordPress 管理员会话并完全接管站点：植入后门、篡改内容、窃取数据，甚至横向影响同一托管环境。CVSS 9.8 属最高危级别，公网暴露该插件的站点风险窗口极大。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致目标 WordPress 站点被完全接管。攻击者获得管理员级已认证会话后，可任意创建或删除管理员账户、安装与修改插件和主题、编辑站点文件、投放恶意内容或后门，并读取站点全部数据（含用户与业务数据），可能进一步波及同一主机上的其他应用。

items.title: A flaw was found in 389-ds-base. The server does not discard plaintext bytes already buffered from a client connection when negotiating StartTLS, allowing an on-path attacker to...
items.summary: A flaw was found in 389-ds-base. The server does not discard plaintext bytes already buffered from a client connection when negotiating StartTLS, allowing an on-path attacker to inject a crafted LDAP message that is processed after the TLS upgrade and whose response is delivered to the client in place of the client's own pending operation's response, due to messageID collision. This can cause a client application to treat a failed authentication (bind) attempt as successful.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 389-ds-base（389 Directory Server）被发现存在 StartTLS 明文注入类漏洞。LDAP 的 StartTLS 扩展操作允许客户端在同一条已建立的明文连接上原地升级为 TLS 加密，因此服务器在收到 StartTLS 请求并开始握手时，必须丢弃套接字接收缓冲区中尚未处理的残留明文字节，否则这些字节会在 TLS 会话建立之后被当作加密信道内的合法请求解析执行。该漏洞正是缺少这一清理步骤：服务器在协商 StartTLS 时未清空已从客户端连接缓冲的明文数据。处于网络路径中间的攻击者（on-path / MITM，具备拦截并注入流量的位置）可抢在 TLS 升级前向该连接注入一条精心构造的 LDAP 消息，例如一次 bind 认证请求；由于该消息被缓冲，握手完成后才被服务器取出处理。又因为攻击者构造消息的 messageID 会与客户端稍后发送的待处理操作所用 ID 发生冲突（或复用），服务器会把针对注入消息的响应错误地回送给客户端，替换掉客户端原本期待的操作响应。其直接后果是客户端应用会把一次实际失败的 bind 认证当作成功处理，从而在凭据并未真正通过校验的情况下进入已认证状态，使攻击者获得对目录数据的读取甚至修改能力，突破 LDAP 的认证边界。CVSS 3.1 评分为 9.0（AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H），攻击向量为网络、无需认证、无需用户交互，因需占据中间人位置故攻击复杂度为高，但对机密性与完整性影响均为高且作用域发生改变，属于严重级别。本次输入元数据未提供具体受影响版本清单，也未标注该漏洞已列入 KEV 或已存在公开的在野利用证据，因此不应据此推断其已被实际利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 攻击者可借中间人注入把失败认证伪装为成功，直接绕过 LDAP 认证边界，可能导致目录条目被读取或篡改；CVSS 9.0，无需认证与用户交互。虽需处于网络路径中间位置，但对以 389-ds-base 作为统一身份源的环境风险极高，应优先评估修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可使客户端将失败的 bind 认证误判为成功，形成认证绕过，攻击者可能以已认证身份访问或修改目录中的敏感数据。影响范围覆盖机密性与完整性（均为高），作用域改变，服务可用性未受影响；前提是攻击者能位于客户端与服务器之间的网络路径上。

items.title: Mooncake transfer engine before 0.3.13 contains an untrusted pointer dereference in ServerSession::readHeader that allows unauthenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary p...
items.summary: Mooncake transfer engine before 0.3.13 contains an untrusted pointer dereference in ServerSession::readHeader that allows unauthenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary process memory via the TCP transport data port. Attackers can send a crafted SessionHeader with arbitrary addr and size values using READ or WRITE opcodes to disclose KV cache contents, prompts and secrets or corrupt memory toward code execution.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Mooncake 传输引擎 (transfer engine) 0.3.13 之前的版本中,具体缺陷点是服务端会话处理函数 ServerSession::readHeader。Mooncake 是面向大模型推理场景的高性能数据传输组件,常用于在预填充节点与解码节点之间搬运 KV Cache,其 TCP 传输数据端口需要处理来自对端的会话头 (SessionHeader) 消息。readHeader 在解析该头部时,直接信任了其中由对端提供的地址 (addr) 与长度 (size) 字段,并在未做任何边界校验、归属校验或权限校验的情况下将其作为本地指针使用,构成典型的不可信指针解引用 (untrusted pointer dereference) 问题。攻击者只要能够访问到该 TCP 数据端口,即可在未经过任何身份认证的情况下,构造带有任意 addr 与 size 值的 SessionHeader,并配合 READ 或 WRITE 操作码发起请求:使用 READ 语义可将服务进程任意地址的内存内容回传给攻击者,从而泄露 KV Cache 中的上下文内容、用户提示词 (prompts) 以及进程中驻留的密钥、令牌等敏感数据;使用 WRITE 语义则可向任意地址写入受控数据,破坏进程内存结构,进而可能劫持控制流并最终实现远程代码执行。由于该组件在网络上的数据端口通常为明文 TCP 且缺乏认证机制,利用条件非常低,无需任何前置凭证或用户交互。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H),属于严重级别。目前该条目在输入数据中未标记列入 KEV,也未标记存在在野利用,故不对此作任何推断。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞无需认证即可通过 TCP 数据端口触发,既可读取进程内存导致 KV Cache、提示词与密钥泄露,也可写入内存进而可能代码执行;CVSS 9.8,且 Mooncake 常部署于大模型推理集群东西向流量中,一旦暴露风险极高。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可造成机密性、完整性、可用性全面失守:泄露 KV Cache、用户提示词及进程内凭据;篡改内存可导致服务崩溃或远程代码执行,并可能以该节点为跳板横向影响整个推理集群。

items.summary: GetSimple CMS is a content management system (CMS), and GetSimple CMS CE is the community edition of that CMS. Prior to version 1.5, the UpdateCE update form contained no anti-CSRF token, and the POST handler performed no token or request-origin verification. A remote attacker can host a page that auto-submits a forged POST to the update endpoint; when an authenticated administrator visits it, the server performs an attacker-directed download-and-deploy operation in the administrator's session — with no further interaction. Because the deployed content is executed (see the related ZIP-extraction advisory), this yields remote code execution. The url field is additionally written into the form unescaped, providing a secondary HTML-injection sink via a malicious upgrade.json. This issue has been patched in version 1.5.

Because PHP files are written into a web-accessible directory, an attacker who can cause a malicious archive to be processed achieves remote code execution as the web-server user. Entry names are also used unsafely, allowing directory traversal (../) to write files outside the intended extraction directory. This issue has been patched in version 1.5.

items.summary: GetSimple CMS is a content management system (CMS), and GetSimple CMS CE is the community edition of that CMS. In version 3.3.22, the password reset endpoint can be accessed without authentication. When a reset request is submitted for an existing user, the application generates a new temporary password and immediately stores its hash as the user's new password. The temporary password is generated using PHP rand() seeded with microtime(). Because this seed is time-based and has a limited effective search space, an attacker can generate possible reset password candidates. Since the admin login endpoint does not enforce rate limiting or account lockout, these candidates can be tested online until the correct password is found. Successful exploitation may lead to administrator account takeover. At time of publication, there are no publicly available patches.

items.title: Capacitor is a cross-platform native runtime for web applications. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1, the Android and iOS WebView navigation guard validates...
items.summary: Capacitor is a cross-platform native runtime for web applications. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.2, 7.6.9, 8.3.5, 8.4.3, and 8.5.1, the Android and iOS WebView navigation guard validates a target URL's host and scheme but not its path, allowing a victim who activates an untrusted link to navigate a frame to /_capacitor_http_interceptor_. The native proxy can fetch an attacker-selected URL and return the response as a document at the application's own origin, allowing script in that response to access same-origin storage, cookies, and registered Capacitor plugin capabilities. Applications remain affected when CapacitorHttp is disabled because affected releases serve the proxy path regardless of that setting. items.summary: A flaw was found in 389-ds-base. An unauthenticated remote attacker can send a complete LDAP operation followed by the first bytes of an incomplete LDAPMessage on the same connection, causing the server to hand that connection to a second worker thread before the first worker's result is flushed. The second worker blocks until nsslapd-ioblocktimeout while holding the connection mutex, preventing delivery of the completed operation's result. Repeating this across a small number of connections proportional to the configured worker-thread pool size exhausts the entire pool under default configuration, denying service to all clients (anonymous and authenticated, plaintext and TLS) for as long as the attacker maintains the connections.

items.title: Out-of-bounds Write (CWE-787) in the PEA archive extraction routine (pea.pas, unpea_procedure) of...
items.summary: Out-of-bounds Write (CWE-787) in the PEA archive extraction routine (pea.pas, unpea_procedure) of the first-party pea component in PeaZip 11.2.0 and earlier allows an attacker who convinces a victim to open or extract a crafted .pea archive to execute arbitrary code as the user running PeaZip. While decompressing a PCOMPRESS1 stream, the 32-bit compressed-block-size field of the first block (compsize) is read directly from the archive and used without validation as the length of a blockread into the fixed-size global buffers wbuf1/wbuf2 (1,114,112 bytes) and as the bound of the subsequent copy loop. The existing check "compsize > WBUFSIZE" is applied only to the size of each following block, so the first block escapes it; the same unvalidated value is also used to index wbuf1[compsize], an out-of-bounds read at an attacker-chosen offset. The copy loop additionally copies the requested length instead of the number of bytes actually read, and terminates on equality rather than on an upper bound. Because the project is built without range checking and no archive password, integrity tag or non-default configuration is required, the overflow overwrites adjacent global data; code execution was demonstrated by two independent researchers against the official Linux x86-64 and Windows x64 builds, and the denial-of-service and memory-corruption primitive is cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux, BSD).

items.title: RT-Labs AB C-Open CANopen contains a write protection bypass in the SDO (Service Data Object)...
items.summary: RT-Labs AB C-Open CANopen contains a write protection bypass in the SDO (Service Data Object) server implementation 'src/co_sdo_server.c' that fails to properly validate write permissions when processing download-segment frames. An unauthenticated attacker on the CAN bus can initiate an SDO upload for a read-only Object Dictionary (OD) entry, which sets a data pointer to the read-only object, then send download-segment frames to write to that memory location. The download-segment handler does not verify that a download session is active, allowing any CANopen node to overwrite read-only OD entries using two SDO frames. Note that CANopen protocol operates over CAN bus and does not provide built-in authentication mechanisms. Fixed in 1.1.1.

items.title: The Smile parser in FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary never invokes StreamReadConstraints...
items.summary: The Smile parser in FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary never invokes StreamReadConstraints.validateNameLength() when decoding JSON object property names, so the maxNameLength limit is not enforced for this format. SmileParser._handleLongFieldName() grows its internal name buffer through an unconstrained _growArrayTo() call and performs no length validation. An attacker who can have a Smile document parsed may therefore embed a single property name of unbounded length; the parser buffers the whole name in memory before returning it, whatever maxNameLength is configured to. Because StreamReadConstraints.maxDocumentLength is also disabled by default, nothing else bounds the name under default settings, so the only limits are the attacker's upload capacity and available heap, leading to memory exhaustion and denial of service. No privileges beyond the ability to submit data to a parsing endpoint are required, and exploitation needs only that the bytes reach SmileFactory parsing, directly or through an ObjectMapper configured with the Smile module. jackson-core's own JSON parsers enforce maxNameLength incrementally during name decoding; this gap is specific to the binary formats. maxNameLength and validateNameLength were introduced in jackson-core 2.16.0, so releases before 2.16.0 do not contain the constraint that is left unenforced. This issue is tracked together with the CBOR parser defect in the same vendor advisory, GHSA-3v8f-v6vx-fmrm, which covers both binary formats. The Smile parser defect (jackson-dataformats-binary issue #726) is CVE-2026-68496; the CBOR parser defect (issue #725) is assigned CVE-2026-68495.

items.summary: A flaw was found in rubygem-katello. The RegistryProxiesController in Katello contains an authorization bypass vulnerability due to an execution fall-through in the registry_authorize filter. While the application identifies unauthorized requests and triggers an error response via the unauthorized method, it fails to halt the execution of the current code path (missing return statement). This failure in the control flow allows the application to proceed into subsequent business logic and database validation filters. Consequently, the application reveals its internal state through differential responses, allowing an unprivileged attacker to enumerate valid Users, Organizations, and Products across the entire instance.

items.title: vm2: Incomplete nodejs.* symbol filtering lets sandbox override host WebStream state checks
items.summary:
## Summary

vm2 current head (`v3.11.5`, commit `7a1f5100b96f48d34e0fe104ab37c0acc5944f92`) still exposes registered Node.js internal symbols from host WebStream prototypes to sandbox code.

The prior `nodejs.*` symbol hardening blocks `Symbol.for('nodejs.<name>')` at the source, but the extraction filters and bridge write traps still enumerate a fixed set of known registered symbols. On Node.js `v25.8.0`, `stream/web` exposes two additional registered symbols:

- `nodejs.stream.disturbed`
- `nodejs.stream.errored`

Sandbox code can extract those real host symbols with `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(streamWeb.ReadableStream.prototype)` and then use them as write keys on host objects. On a real host `ReadableStream`, an attacker can make `stream.Readable.isDisturbed(stream)` return `false` after the stream has already been read.

## Technical Details

`lib/setup-sandbox.js` correctly blocks future `nodejs.*` keys at the `Symbol.for()` source:

```js
if (apply(localStringStartsWith, keyStr, ['nodejs.'])) {
  ...
  return fresh;
}
```

However, the extraction filters are still driven by a fixed `realDangerousSymbols` list. That list does not include `nodejs.stream.disturbed` or `nodejs.stream.errored`, so `Object.getOwnPropertySymbols()` and related paths can still return those real host symbols.

`lib/bridge.js` has the same fixed-list problem in `isDangerousCrossRealmSymbol()` and in the host-result scrub list. Because the two new symbols are not recognized, the `set` and `defineProperty` traps allow sandbox-originated writes using those keys.

Current-head source references:

- `lib/setup-sandbox.js:180-196` denies `Symbol.for('nodejs.*')` by namespace.
- `lib/setup-sandbox.js:214-230` uses a fixed `realDangerousSymbols` list for extraction filtering; the two reported symbols are absent.
- `lib/bridge.js:187-199` uses a fixed `isDangerousCrossRealmSymbol()` list; the two reported symbols are absent.
- `lib/bridge.js:1499-1509` treats the write trap as the last line of defense, but it only rejects keys recognized by that fixed list.

## Impact

Sandbox code can corrupt host-visible WebStream state checks for host WebStream objects that cross into the sandbox. In the validated PoV, a stream that the host has already consumed is made to appear undisturbed to `stream.Readable.isDisturbed()`.

This can bypass host logic that relies on Node's public stream-state helpers to enforce one-shot body consumption, reject errored streams, or decide whether a host WebStream is safe to hand to another component.

This is not a host-code-execution primitive in the current PoV. The report is an incomplete-fix / guard-coverage gap in the same symbol-boundary family as the prior `nodejs.*` symbol advisory.

## Affected Package/Versions

Confirmed affected on Node.js `v25.8.0`:

- `v3.11.4`
- `v3.11.5`
- current head `7a1f5100b96f48d34e0fe104ab37c0acc5944f92`

`v3.11.3` is also affected, but it predates the broader `nodejs.*` symbol fix. For this incomplete-fix report, the suggested affected range is `>= 3.11.4, <= 3.11.5` on Node.js versions where these stream symbols exist.

No patched version is known.

## Configuration Required

The PoV uses a `VM` where the embedder exposes a host WebStream object and the host `stream/web` module object to sandbox code:

```js
const vm = new VM({ sandbox: { rs, streamWeb } });
```

This matches the same trust boundary as the earlier cross-realm symbol-write class: sandbox code must not be able to obtain registered Node.js internal symbols and write them back onto host objects.

The PoV is local-only. It does not require network access, a public target, `NodeVM` builtin access, `process`, filesystem access, or child-process access.


items.title: devalue: `stringify`/`uneval` serialize shared memory
items.summary:
### Impact

`stringify` and `uneval` serialize a typed array by emitting its backing `ArrayBuffer`, not just the view. In the case of a Node `Buffer` object, the backing buffer is a process-wide shared pool, meaning unrelated memory can be serialized into a response that is then sent to the client. For a Node `Buffer` the backing store is Node's **process-wide shared pool**, so serializing a small `Buffer` copies up to 64 KB of unrelated process memory — including bytes from other in-flight requests — into the output. In an SSR framework (SvelteKit, Nuxt) a public page whose `load()` returns a 2-byte `Buffer`, or a small file read with `readFileSync`, ships another user's request body / `Authorization` header in its HTML. Unauthenticated, silent, ~43,000× amplification.

This is serialization-side, so the `parse`/`unflatten` prototype-pollution and DoS guards do not apply — it fires on every SSR render, not only when parsing untrusted input.

### Workarounds

Convert Node `Buffer` objects to `Uint8Array`:

```diff
payload = {
- buffer
+ buffer: new Uint8Array(buffer)
}
```

items.title: Aletheia: Permission-Minimality Testing for Coding-Agent Rules
items.summary: Repository instruction files guide coding agents, but also expose them to prompt injection. Malicious rules can request credential access or data transfer while the agent produces a correct patch. We present Aletheia, a framework for permission-minimality testing. Aletheia translates requested authority into a typed language and synthesizes executable sandbox configurations. It runs the unchanged rule and task under full permissions and independent restrictions that remove one permission at a time. Passing independent functional tests under strictly reduced authority provides a dispensability witness, which Aletheia interprets against task context to diagnose suspicious requests. We formalize synthesis and the conditions connecting witnesses to enforced restrictions. On a shared refactoring task, Aletheia executes and detects all 314 AIShellJack attack inputs, with no alarms on five benign templates. Among 80 manually verified benign GHAgentFiles rules, it raises three false positives (3.75%).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注一个新兴的供应链式风险面：仓库中的指令文件（如各类 agent 规则文件）在指导编码智能体的同时，也可能成为提示注入的载体。作者指出，恶意规则可以在智能体仍能产出“正确补丁”的前提下，悄悄索取凭据访问权限或数据外传能力，因此常规的功能性测试无法发现这类越权。为此论文提出 Aletheia 框架，核心思想是“权限最小化测试”：把规则所请求的权限翻译成一种带类型的语言，据此合成可执行的沙箱配置；随后在两种条件下运行同一套未经修改的规则与任务——一次给予完整权限，一次施加逐项剥离权限的独立限制。如果在严格削减权限后，规则仍能通过独立的功能测试，就得到一份“可弃置性见证”（dispensability witness），说明该权限对完成任务并非必要；Aletheia 再结合任务上下文对该见证进行解释，从而诊断出可疑的权限请求。论文同时对配置合成过程以及“见证”与被实际执行的限制之间的关联条件进行了形式化定义，使判定不依赖启发式猜测。实验方面，在共享的重构任务上，Aletheia 对全部 314 条 AIShellJack 攻击输入均成功执行并触发告警，同时对五个良性模板保持零误报；在 80 条经人工核验为良性的 GHAgentFiles 规则上仅产生 3 个误报，误报率 3.75%。论文属于防御性研究，主要面向编码智能体平台、CI/CD 流水线以及 agent 规则生态的构建者与安全审查人员。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 编码智能体规则文件正成为被忽视的权限入口，恶意规则可在补丁“看起来正确”时窃取凭据或外传数据。该工作把权限最小化从原则变成可执行的检测手段，并给出了低误报的量化证据，对 agent 供应链与 CI/CD 安全审查有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于仓库指令文件与 agent 规则集的准入审查、编码智能体沙箱权限收敛、CI/CD 中智能体执行的权限基线校验；其“逐项剥离权限 + 功能测试仍通过”的判定思路可迁移到 MCP 工具授权、插件权限声明、容器 capabilities 最小化等场景。
detection_signals_zh: 规则在权限被逐项移除后，功能测试仍然通过，形成“非必要权限”见证
规则显式索取凭据读取、环境变量访问或外部数据外传类权限，而任务上下文并不需要
同一套功能测试在完整权限与受限权限下均通过，但权限声明集合明显超出任务所需
在共享重构类任务中出现与功能无关的额外授权请求
defense_advice_zh: 对仓库中的 agent 规则文件实行权限白名单与人工复核，尤其是涉及凭据、网络外传的声明
在沙箱中以“完整权限 vs 逐项削减权限”对照运行，把仍能通过功能测试的多余权限标记为可疑并回收
将权限最小化测试纳入 CI 门禁，对新增权限声明阻断式审查
把规则文件视为可执行的供应链资产，纳入版本变更审计与来源信任管理
对高权限请求结合具体任务上下文判定，避免仅凭关键词规则产生大量误报

items.title: The CTX Feed Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 7.6.12. This is due to insufficient input validation on the 'Feed Con...
items.summary: The CTX Feed Pro plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 7.6.12. This is due to insufficient input validation on the 'Feed Config' field which is passed directly to the eval() function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Administrator-level access and above, to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-10026 是 WordPress 第三方插件 CTX Feed Pro（用于生成产品数据 Feed 的商业插件）中的一个代码注入漏洞，影响所有 7.6.12 及更早版本。漏洞根因在于插件对 'Feed Config'（Feed 配置）字段缺乏充分的输入校验，该字段的值被直接传入 PHP 的 eval() 函数执行。eval() 会把字符串当作 PHP 代码解析并运行，因此任何能够控制该字段内容的人，都等同于获得了在该 WordPress 站点所运行服务器上执行任意 PHP 代码的能力。根据官方描述，触发该漏洞需要攻击者已通过身份认证并拥有 Administrator（管理员）及以上级别的权限，也就是说这是一个典型的'高权限后置利用'型缺陷：它本身不是未授权入口，但会把管理员级别的配置能力放大为服务器端的任意代码执行，从而彻底突破 WordPress 的应用层边界，导致服务器被完全接管。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 7.2（向量 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H），属于高危级别；其中 PR:H 反映了必须持有高权限账户这一前提，而机密性、完整性与可用性影响均为 High，说明一旦满足前提条件，后果是全面且不可逆的。当前元数据中未提供 EPSS 评分、受影响产品清单与厂商信息，也未标记该漏洞已被列入 CVE 已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），元数据中亦无在野利用标记，因此不应推断其已遭实际攻击。对防御方而言，关键动作是尽快将 CTX Feed Pro 升级到 7.6.12 之后的修复版本；在补丁可用或完成升级之前，应严格收敛管理员账户的数量与来源，避免使用弱口令与共享账号，并对相关管理界面的访问实施网络层访问控制与审计。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许已认证的管理员通过 Feed 配置字段向 eval() 注入 PHP 代码，在服务器上实现任意代码执行，等同于站点与主机完全失陷。虽需高权限前提，但管理员账号被窃取、内部人员滥用或权限提升链配合时即可触发，且影响机密性、完整性与可用性，属高危。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致服务器端任意 PHP 代码执行，攻击者能够读取、篡改或删除站点数据与文件，植入持久化后门，横向移动至同主机其他服务，并造成业务中断（C/I/A 均为 High）。前提是攻击者已持有 Administrator 及以上权限的账户。

items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/activities/btn_functions.php?action=activity. The manipulation of the argument Title results in sql injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞披露于 NVD，影响 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0。问题出在文件 /reviewer_0/admins/assessments/activities/btn_functions.php 中 action=activity 分支所对应的功能：程序在处理 Title 参数时未做充分的输入校验与参数化处理，直接把用户可控的字符串拼接到 SQL 查询中，从而形成 SQL 注入。攻击者可以通过网络远程发送构造好的请求来操纵 Title 参数，无需认证（PR:N）、无需用户交互（UI:N），利用条件很低（AC:L），因此 CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 7.3，属于高危级别。从影响维度看，该漏洞对机密性、完整性、可用性的影响均为低（C:L/I:L/A:L），即攻击者可能读取数据库中的账号、评审记录、配置等敏感信息，或篡改、删除部分数据，严重时可为后续横向渗透或权限提升提供跳板。受影响范围方面，厂商与具体受影响产品版本信息在本次元数据中未提供，仅知为 SourceCodester Online Reviewer Management System 1.0；该类开源 PHP 教学/练手项目通常缺乏持续维护和官方补丁，常被直接部署在互联网上。公开信息显示该漏洞的利用细节已经公开，可能被自动化扫描器与批量攻击工具纳入，但当前数据中并未标注其已在野利用、也未列入 KEV。防御侧应以资产排查和输入处理加固为核心，并评估是否继续对公网暴露该系统。

items.title: A security vulnerability has been detected in modelcontextprotocol mcp-server-fetch and mcp-server-everything up to 2026.6.4. Affected is the function fetch_url of the file mcp_...
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in modelcontextprotocol mcp-server-fetch and mcp-server-everything up to 2026.6.4. Affected is the function fetch_url of the file mcp_server_fetch/server.py of the component Fetch Tool. The manipulation of the argument url/path leads to server-side request forgery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-104120 是 modelcontextprotocol 官方示例项目中 mcp-server-fetch 与 mcp-server-everything 组件（版本至 2026.6.4）被披露的一处服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞。问题位于 mcp_server_fetch/server.py 中负责抓取远端内容的 fetch_url 函数：该函数在处理传入的 url/path 参数时，未能对目标地址进行充分的校验与白名单限制，攻击者可以构造特定参数，诱使服务端向任意内网或外部地址发起 HTTP 请求。由于 Fetch Tool 本身就是 MCP（Model Context Protocol）生态中供大模型调用的网页抓取能力，攻击面不止于传统 Web 服务，还包括经由 AI Agent/LLM 工具链触发的间接调用，因此远端攻击者可在无需认证（PR:N）、无需用户交互（UI:N）的条件下发起利用，CVSS 3.1 基础分为 7.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），整体评级为高危。NVD 描述指出该漏洞的利用细节已被公开披露，可能被直接使用；同时官方用于修复该问题的 Pull Request 尚处于待合并（await acceptance）状态，意味着上游尚无已发布的正式修复版本。目前元数据中未提供受影响产品清单与厂商信息，也未列入 CISA KEV，且明确标注未观察到在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MCP 抓取类服务常被部署在内网并供 AI Agent 调用，SSRF 可被用于探测内网资产、访问云元数据接口或绕过网络边界，且利用细节已公开、官方修复 PR 尚未合入，风险窗口期较长。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致服务端代攻击者向内网/受保护地址发起请求，造成内网信息探测与泄露、访问云环境元数据凭证、以及对内部服务的未授权交互；不影响数据机密性/完整性/可用性均仅为低度（C:L/I:L/A:L），但可成为进一步横向移动的跳板。

items.why_it_matters: MCP 抓取类服务常被部署在内网并供 AI Agent 调用，SSRF 可被用于探测内网资产、访问云元数据接口或绕过网络边界，且利用细节已公开、官方修复 PR 尚未合入，风险窗口期较长。

items.title: Improper access control in ManagedProvisioning prior to SMR Sep-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to install arbitrary applications.
items.summary: Improper access control in ManagedProvisioning prior to SMR Sep-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to install arbitrary applications.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞位于 Android 平台的 ManagedProvisioning 组件，该组件负责设备托管与配置流程，包括设备所有者（Device Owner）、工作资料（Work Profile）以及企业移动管理（EMM/MDM）场景下的预配置逻辑，通常以较高权限运行。漏洞性质为访问控制不当（Improper access control），即组件在关键操作上未能正确校验调用方身份或权限边界。根据厂商披露，具备本地访问条件的攻击者可借此绕过既有权限限制，在受影响设备上安装任意应用程序。修复被纳入 SMR Sep-2026 Release 1，即 2026 年 9 月的安全维护版本（SMR 为终端厂商面向 Android 设备的月度安全补丁节奏，通常以补丁级别字符串随 OTA 下发）。当前 NVD 记录未提供 CVSS 向量与评分，也未提供 EPSS 分值，且未列入 KEV 目录，来源字段亦未标注在野利用，因此本摘要不对实际可利用性与真实攻击活动做任何推断。利用通常需要攻击者已在目标设备上取得本地代码执行能力或具备一定本地权限，例如通过已安装的恶意应用或物理接触设备，因此属于需要前置条件的本地提权/绕过类问题，而非可直接远程触发。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ManagedProvisioning 承担设备托管与企业策略配置，权限较高；该缺陷可被本地攻击者用于绕过管控安装任意应用，直接冲击设备完整性与企业 MDM 基线。虽无 CVSS 与在野利用信息，仍应纳入终端补丁合规跟踪。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用后，本地攻击者可在未获授权的情况下安装任意应用，绕过设备托管与策略管控，可能造成持久化驻留、敏感数据窃取、企业策略失效或设备被进一步接管。受影响范围为未升级到 SMR Sep-2026 Release 1 及之后版本的 Android 设备（具体机型与版本需以厂商公告为准）。

items.title: A security flaw has been discovered in calcom cal.diy up to 6.2.0. This affects the function doesUserIdHaveAccessToBooking of the file BookingAccessService.ts of the component P...
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in calcom cal.diy up to 6.2.0. This affects the function doesUserIdHaveAccessToBooking of the file BookingAccessService.ts of the component PBAC Permission Engine. Performing a manipulation results in missing authorization. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-104054 是披露于开源日程预约平台 cal.com 旗下项目 cal.diy（受影响版本至 6.2.0）的一处授权缺失（Missing Authorization）缺陷。问题出在 BookingAccessService.ts 文件中的 doesUserIdHaveAccessToBooking 函数，该函数属于 PBAC（Policy-Based Access Control，基于策略的访问控制）权限引擎组件，职责是判定给定用户 ID 是否有权访问某条具体预约记录。由于该函数在访问判定逻辑上存在缺陷，攻击者只需对相关请求参数进行人为构造与篡改（manipulation），即可绕过授权检查，以本不应具备的权限访问他人预约数据或执行越权操作。该缺陷可由远程发起，无需任何用户交互，但要求攻击者持有低权限账户（有效登录态）。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L，基础分 6.3，属中等严重度：机密性、完整性、可用性三方面均为低度受损，范围不变。上游描述同时指出，针对该问题的利用方法已被公开发布，可能被用于实际攻击；而修复该问题的 pull request 目前仍处于待接受状态，意味着官方主线代码可能尚未包含修复，受影响部署在补丁合并前将持续暴露。需要特别说明的是，NVD 元数据中未将该 CVE 列入 KEV，也未标记 exploit_in_the_wild/known_exploited 为 true，因此不能认定已存在经官方确认的在野利用，只应按“存在公开可用的概念验证/利用信息”这一事实提高警惕。建议运行 cal.diy 6.2.0 及更早版本的团队优先评估自身是否暴露于互联网、是否存在多租户或共享部署场景，并跟踪上游修复 PR 的合并与正式版本发布情况。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该缺陷直接冲击多租户预约系统的访问控制边界，任意低权限用户都可能越权读取或改动他人预约数据，涉及个人隐私与日程信息。利用门槛低、可远程触发，且上游描述称利用代码已公开，虽未被列入 KEV，仍值得尽快排查与修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可绕过 PBAC 权限引擎的预约访问判定，以普通登录用户身份越权访问、篡改或影响他人的预约记录。CVSS 3.1 评分 6.3（AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L），机密性、完整性、可用性均为低度影响。利用方式已公开，攻击者可远程、无需交互地发起尝试，未确认在野利用。

items.why_it_matters: 该缺陷直接冲击多租户预约系统的访问控制边界，任意低权限用户都可能越权读取或改动他人预约数据，涉及个人隐私与日程信息。利用门槛低、可远程触发，且上游描述称利用代码已公开，虽未被列入 KEV，仍值得尽快排查与修复。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Pet Shop Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file admin_reservefilter.php. Such manipulation...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Pet Shop Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file admin_reservefilter.php. Such manipulation of the argument filter leads to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-104053 是 NVD 收录的一则 SQL 注入漏洞, 影响 itsourcecode 出品的 Pet Shop Management System 1.0(宠物店管理系统)的管理后台过滤功能。漏洞根因在于 admin_reservefilter.php 文件中某个尚未公开命名的函数对请求参数 filter 未做充分的输入校验与参数化处理, 攻击者通过构造恶意的 filter 取值即可将畸形 SQL 片段注入到后端数据库查询中, 从而干扰查询逻辑。该缺陷可通过网络远程触发, 属于典型的远程 SQL 注入。根据 CVSS 3.1 评估, 该漏洞得分 6.3, 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L, 即攻击者需先具备低权限账户(PR:L), 无需用户交互, 成功利用后可对数据的机密性、完整性与可用性造成有限影响。NVD 描述指出该漏洞的利用代码已公开可用, 并可能被滥用, 但截至当前输入数据未见其被列入 CISA KEV, 也未见 EPSS 评分或厂商通告, 因此尚无证据表明已在真实环境中遭在野利用。由于 itsourcecode 系列项目多为教学/演示性质的轻量级 Web 应用, 官方修复节奏与补丁分发往往不确定, 使用方需自行评估风险。修复方向是停止将 filter 参数直接拼接进 SQL 语句, 改用预编译参数化查询或白名单校验, 并配合数据库最小权限原则与网络层访问控制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 远程 SQL 注入可导致后台数据被读取或篡改, 且公开的利用代码降低了攻击门槛, 使用该系统的站点存在被批量扫描命中的风险; 目前已确认低权限账户即可触发, 但暂无在野利用证据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者以低权限账户经由远程请求注入 SQL, 可有限度地读取、篡改业务数据并影响服务可用性, 为后续提权或数据窃取提供跳板。

items.why_it_matters: 远程 SQL 注入可导致后台数据被读取或篡改, 且公开的利用代码降低了攻击门槛, 使用该系统的站点存在被批量扫描命中的风险; 目前已确认低权限账户即可触发, 但暂无在野利用证据。

items.title: ClipBucket v5 through 5.5.3-#197 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with ad_manager_access permission to inject SQL via the delete parameter...
items.summary: ClipBucket v5 through 5.5.3-#197 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with ad_manager_access permission to inject SQL via the delete parameter in admin_area/ads_manager.php. Attackers can supply time-based blind payloads concatenated into AdsManager::DeleteAd queries to extract user credentials and emails or modify and delete arbitrary records.

llm_summary.summary_zh: ClipBucket v5（影响范围至 5.5.3-#197）存在一处 SQL 注入漏洞，问题代码位于管理后台文件 admin_area/ads_manager.php。触发参数为 delete，该参数的值在未做参数化绑定、也未做充分过滤的情况下，被直接拼接进 AdsManager::DeleteAd 所执行的 SQL 查询语句中。利用该漏洞需要前置条件：攻击者必须已通过身份认证，并且其账号被授予 ad_manager_access（广告管理）权限，因此属于「高权限账户可触发的注入」类型。具备该权限的攻击者可向 delete 参数注入基于时间盲注（time-based blind）的载荷，借助数据库响应延迟差异，逐字符推断查询结果，从而提取用户凭据（用户名/口令散列）与电子邮件地址等敏感信息；同一注入点还可用于修改或删除数据库中任意记录，导致数据完整性与可用性受损。CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H，基础评分 7.2，属高危级别：网络可达、利用复杂度低、无需用户交互，但需要高权限。当前 EPSS 无评分数据，未列入 KEV 目录，来源字段亦标记为未发现在野利用，因此暂无证据表明该漏洞已被实际利用或武器化。防御重心应放在升级到修复版本、收敛管理后台网络暴露面、对高权限账号执行最小权限与审计，以及对后台参数输入实施白名单与参数化查询校验。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该注入点位于管理后台，可直接读取用户凭据与邮箱并篡改或删除任意记录，破坏数据机密性与完整性。虽需较高权限前置条件，但一旦高权限账号被滥用或凭据泄露，即成倍放大风险，CVSS 7.2 属高危，应尽快修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致数据库敏感信息泄露，包括用户凭据与电子邮箱地址，同时攻击者可修改或删除任意数据库记录，造成数据完整性与业务可用性受损。利用需已认证且具备 ad_manager_access 权限的账号。

items.why_it_matters: 该注入点位于管理后台，可直接读取用户凭据与邮箱并篡改或删除任意记录，破坏数据机密性与完整性。虽需较高权限前置条件，但一旦高权限账号被滥用或凭据泄露，即成倍放大风险，CVSS 7.2 属高危，应尽快修复。

items.title: Mooncake transfer engine through 0.3.13.post1 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in TransferMetadata::receivePeerNotify that allows unauthenticated attackers to grow pro...
items.summary: Mooncake transfer engine through 0.3.13.post1 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in TransferMetadata::receivePeerNotify that allows unauthenticated attackers to grow process memory without limit. Attackers can repeatedly send notify frames up to 1 MB to the handshake RPC port, filling the uncapped notifys vector until the out-of-memory killer terminates the engine.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103761 是 Mooncake 传输引擎（Mooncake transfer engine，常用于大模型推理场景下 KV Cache / 张量的跨节点高速传输）中披露的一个内存耗尽型拒绝服务漏洞，影响版本为 0.3.13.post1 及之前的所有版本。问题定位在 TransferMetadata::receivePeerNotify 这一处理对端通知（peer notify）的函数上：该函数在接收握手 RPC 端口上收到的 notify 帧时，会将其追加进内部名为 notifys 的容器（vector），但该容器没有设置容量上限或基于会话的配额，也没有在追加前做来源认证。因此，任何能够访问握手 RPC 端口的未认证远程攻击者，只需重复发送大小接近 1 MB 的 notify 帧，即可让 notifys 容器无限制增长，进程常驻内存随之持续膨胀。当内存占用超过系统可用内存阈值时，Linux OOM killer 会将该引擎进程终止，导致传输服务不可用，进而影响依赖该引擎的推理任务与数据传输链路。漏洞的 CVSS 3.1 向量为 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H，基础评分 7.5，属于高严重度：攻击无需认证、无需用户交互、网络可达即可触发，作用域不变，仅造成可用性影响，不涉及机密性或完整性。当前输入数据未显示该 CVE 被列入 KEV 或存在在野利用标注，EPSS 评分亦缺失，因此应视为已公开但利用状态未知的拒绝服务风险。从防御角度看，需在受影响版本上升级到修复版本，并同步收敛握手 RPC 端口的网络暴露面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证即可远程触发，能让 Mooncake 传输引擎内存无上限增长直至被 OOM killer 杀死，直接中断大模型推理的 KV Cache 与张量传输链路。若握手 RPC 端口暴露在公网或横向可达网段，攻击者可用极低成本造成长时间服务不可用，属于典型的高危可用性风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用导致引擎进程内存耗尽并被系统 OOM killer 终止，传输服务中断、推理任务失败或长时间不可用；不造成数据泄露或篡改，仅影响可用性（C:N/I:N/A:H）。

items.why_it_matters: 无需认证即可远程触发，能让 Mooncake 传输引擎内存无上限增长直至被 OOM killer 杀死，直接中断大模型推理的 KV Cache 与张量传输链路。若握手 RPC 端口暴露在公网或横向可达网段，攻击者可用极低成本造成长时间服务不可用，属于典型的高危可用性风险。

items.title: Mooncake transfer engine through 0.3.13.post1 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to block the handshake daemon by never read...
items.summary: Mooncake transfer engine through 0.3.13.post1 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to block the handshake daemon by never reading replies. Attackers can send a Metadata request to the handshake RPC port and stall SocketHandShakePlugin's single listener thread in writeFully(), breaking all subsequent handshakes, metadata fetches, notify and probe requests.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-103760 是 Mooncake 传输引擎 (transfer engine) 在 0.3.13.post1 及之前版本中存在的一个拒绝服务 (DoS) 漏洞。Mooncake 是一个面向大模型推理/分布式场景的高性能数据传输组件, 其握手 (handshake) 服务通过 RPC 端口对外提供连接建立、元数据获取、通知与探测等功能。该漏洞的核心问题在于 SocketHandShakePlugin 采用了单一监听线程来处理连接, 并且在向对端写回响应时使用了 writeFully() 这一阻塞式全量写入逻辑。攻击者无需任何认证, 只需向握手 RPC 端口发送一个 Metadata (元数据) 请求, 随后始终不去读取服务端返回的响应数据。由于 TCP 接收端不读取, 发送端的 socket 发送缓冲区很快被填满, writeFully() 便会在该连接上持续阻塞, 从而把唯一的监听线程长时间卡死。监听线程被占用后, 后续所有客户端的握手请求、元数据获取、notify 通知以及 probe 探测请求都无法被受理, 造成大范围的连接失败与服务不可用, 形成典型的低速、低成本远程拒绝服务效果。NVD 给出的 CVSS 3.1 评分为 5.9 (AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H), 攻击向量为网络, 无需认证与用户交互, 主要影响可用性 (高), 但攻击复杂度被评为较高, 因此定级为中等。该漏洞未列入 KEV, 元数据中也未标注存在野外利用证据。修复思路上, 建议升级至 0.3.13.post1 之后的修复版本; 若暂时无法升级, 应通过防火墙/安全组限制握手 RPC 端口的访问来源, 仅允许可信网段连接; 同时可考虑在服务端加强发送超时、连接并发处理与读写超时配置, 避免单一连接阻塞全局监听线程。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证即可通过一条不读取回包的 Metadata 请求阻塞唯一握手监听线程, 导致整个集群的握手与元数据服务瘫痪, 属低成本远程 DoS, 对依赖 Mooncake 的分布式推理与训练环境可用性影响明显。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 受影响版本 Mooncake transfer engine <= 0.3.13.post1, 暴露握手 RPC 端口的服务可被远程未认证攻击者持续拒绝服务, 表现为新的握手、元数据获取、notify 与 probe 请求全部失败。CVSS 5.9 (中等), 仅影响可用性。

items.title: PACE: Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement for Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents turn generated text into real side effects, so poisoned tool metadata, retrieved pages, memory, and reusable skills can steer the next call. Vetting an artifact before admission does not settle this. A safe variant and a leaking variant can produce the same admission evidence, and a sound gate then cannot relax that site for either. We make that condition precise, which leaves the last boundary a deployment can still act on. We present Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement (PACE), which mediates every tool call immediately before it executes. Path confinement proposes an executable cut of represented influence paths, while capability and effect verification checks schema-defined effects against authority compiled from the authenticated request. We distinguish the certified execution contract from the evaluated configuration, which can restore an authorized call after a proposed block or apply a declared repair. Confinement requires the final action to preserve the certified cut. On eight executable agent-security benchmarks with three target-model families, the evaluated configuration gives strictly lowest attack success in 62 of 79 eligible attack columns and ties in 14; full-benchmark native utility loses at most three points relative to the undefended agent. A complete ablation over 1167 paired cases attributes most security gains to effect verification and refusal control to boundary adaptation. A reduced-scale adaptive search succeeds on 0/30 out-of-authority targets against the defense.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦工具调用型大语言模型（LLM）智能体的运行时安全问题。此类智能体把模型生成的文本转化为真实世界的副作用（文件写入、API 调用、消息发送等），因此被投毒的工具元数据、检索到的网页、记忆内容以及可复用的技能（skill）都可能操纵下一次工具调用，形成间接提示注入式的攻击面。作者指出，仅在“准入”阶段对工件进行审查（例如入库前过滤、白名单扫描）无法解决问题：一个安全变体与一个会泄露数据的变体可能产生完全相同的准入证据，任何在准入环节成立的判定门（gate）都无法据此对二者区别对待。论文首先把这一条件形式化，说明为什么最后一个仍可被部署方实际控制的边界在“调用即将执行之前”而不是“工件被接纳之时”。基于此，作者提出 PACE（Provenance-Aware Capability Enforcement，来源感知的能力强制），它在每一次工具调用真正执行前进行中介。PACE 包含两个核心机制：一是路径约束（path confinement），它对所表征的影响路径提出一个可执行的切割（executable cut），用来源/传播关系界定某次调用允许触碰的数据与资源范围；二是能力与效果验证（capability and effect verification），把工具模式（schema）中声明的效果与从“已认证请求”编译出的授权进行比对。论文区分了“认证的执行契约”（certified execution contract）与“可评估配置”（evaluated configuration）：后者可以在提出阻断后恢复一次被授权的调用，或应用声明的修复策略。约束机制要求最终动作必须保持被认证的切割不变。实验部分在八个可执行的智能体安全基准、三个目标模型家族上进行评测：可评估配置在 79 个符合条件的攻击列中有 62 个取得严格最低的攻击成功率，另有 14 个持平；在全基准的原始效用（native utility）上，相对无防护智能体最多损失三分。对 1167 组配对样本的完整消融显示，大部分安全收益来自效果验证，而拒答控制来自边界自适应。此外，一个缩减规模的适应性搜索在针对该防御时对越权目标的成功率为 0/30。整体而言，论文把智能体安全从“内容准入”推进到“调用时来源与权限强制”，并提供了可复现的基准与消融证据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 工具调用型智能体的风险最终落地在执行瞬间，准入式过滤（提示词扫描、内容审核、静态白名单）面对证据等价的良性/恶意变体本质失效。PACE 提供了“调用前中介 + 来源切割 + 声明效果对照授权”的工程化思路，并用 8 个基准、3 个模型家族与 1167 组消融给出可复现数据，对构建智能体运行时防护（如 MCP/工具网关、权限代理）具有直接参考价值，可作为下一代策略引擎的设计依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接迁移到智能体工具网关、MCP 服务代理、企业内智能体编排平台与 CI 中的自动化代理等场景：在这些位置插入调用前中介层，用来源追踪限定可触达的资源路径，用工具 schema 声明的效果与请求授权做比对，从而在不牺牲过多原始效用的前提下降低间接注入与数据外泄风险。其“认证契约 vs 可评估配置”的分离也适用于需要审慎放行与可回滚修复的生产治理流程。
detection_signals_zh: 工具调用参数中出现与已认证请求授权不一致的目标资源、路径或接收方
同一次会话内来源链（检索页、记忆、可复用技能、工具元数据）指向的资源路径超出了当前任务所需的切割范围
工具 schema 声明的效果类型（读/写/外发）与实际调用副作用不匹配
调用被策略引擎提出阻断后又被“可评估配置”恢复，且恢复理由无法对应到已认证契约
记忆或技能工件在入库后发生静默变更，随后触发新的工具调用
defense_advice_zh: 把执行前中介作为最后防线：在每次工具调用真正执行前做一次授权校验，而不是只依赖入库/准入时的内容审查
为工具调用建立来源追踪（provenance）与显式的影响路径模型，并对每次调用计算可执行的“切割”，要求最终动作保持该切割不变
以工具 schema 声明的效果为基准，与从已认证用户请求编译出的授权进行比对，效果超出授权即阻断
区分“认证契约”与“可评估配置”，允许在受控条件下恢复合法调用或应用声明式修复，但所有恢复动作必须留下审计记录并可回滚
对记忆与可复用技能工件做版本与完整性监控，变更后重新评估而非继承此前的信任
部署自适应对抗测试（在授权边界外的目标上验证防御有效性），并持续度量安全收益与原始效用的权衡
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：结合自身智能体工具网关评估调用前中介与来源切割的可行性，并复现其消融结论以确认收益来源

items.title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
items.summary: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost. These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本文研究多轮（multi-turn）攻击对智能体（agentic）系统的威胁以及如何在运行时进行防御。作者指出，多轮攻击的关键特征是「组合性」：攻击者可以把每一步单独看都合乎许可的动作，编排成最终有害的结果，这使得那些只孤立评估单个动作或单个状态的防御机制失效，因为在任何单点上都不存在明显违规。论文的核心发现是：这类攻击会在智能体内部表征中留下可检测的痕迹——有害行为表现为随上下文更新而不断累积的表征迁移（accumulated representation transition），而诱发该行为的触发上下文也可以从同一信号中定位出来。

论文同时指出了一个容易被忽视的陷阱：直接用「对比式安全方向」对表征迁移做朴素聚合会被良性表征漂移干扰，因为这样的方向并不保证对良性迁移给出零分，良性流量本身也存在自然的表征变化，会淹没真实攻击信号。为此作者提出对方向进行去噪：把良性流量锚定在零点，并移除其主导的变化方向，且该处理不引入任何运行时开销。

基于这些发现，作者设计了 DART——一个运行时框架，用于检测表征偏移、对其进行归因（指出是哪段上下文触发），并通过定向提醒（targeted reminders）进行干预。实验覆盖六个模型和两个多轮基准：在 MT-AgentRisk 上把攻击成功率从 84% 降到 25%，在平均 12% 误报率下捕获全部攻击；在 ASEval 上从 97% 降到 52%，付出的代价分别是 8% 与 0% 的良性非拒答（benign non-refusal）。在 MT-AgentRisk 上，DART 在全部六个模型上都优于当前最先进的多轮防御 ToolShield（同协议下 ToolShield 仅达 55%）。消融显示去噪至关重要：在 ASEval 上未去噪的监测器只能捕获 7%–40% 的攻击，去噪后可达 60%–85%。此外，同一个监测器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入（indirect injection），每个被监测步骤仅增加 0.14–0.56 秒开销，且不需要辅助模型，可作为计算密集型推测式防御的轻量补充。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把多轮智能体攻击从「行为层难以判定」转化为「表征层可测量的累积偏移」，并给出无需辅助模型、每步仅百毫秒级开销的运行时监测与干预方案，对需要在线防护工具调用类智能体的团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到多轮对话智能体、工具/函数调用型 Agent、企业 LLM 网关与 Agent 运行时沙箱等场景，用于在动作级过滤器之外增加上下文级的表征监测，并与输入/输出过滤、推测式防御形成互补。
detection_signals_zh: 会话内跨上下文更新出现持续累积的内部表征偏移，而非单步异常
每一步动作单独看均合规、但按序组合后整体指向有害目标的行为链
触发有害行为的上下文片段附近表征迁移幅度显著高于该会话良性基线
定向提醒被反复触发的位置（可用于回溯定位风险上下文）
会话长度增长与表征漂移量之间的失配（良性漂移被去噪后仍残留的高幅值信号）
defense_advice_zh: 在动作级校验之外，补充上下文级的表征迁移监测，避免仅做单步评估
用良性流量校准基线并对安全方向做去噪，把良性漂移锚定到零再判定，降低误报
对检出的高风险迁移做归因而不是直接阻断，优先用定向提醒把智能体拉回安全轨道，以控制良性非拒答代价
将该监测器作为轻量旁路与现有输入输出过滤、推测式防御叠加部署，注意每步百毫秒级延迟预算
在多轮基准（如 MT-AgentRisk、ASEval 类场景）与自建业务场景上分别评估误报率与漏报率，按业务风险调整阈值
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: ActionGuard: Tool Call Authorization under Poisoned Skills
items.summary: LLM-based agents extend their capabilities through third-party skills that provide task-specific instructions, scripts, and tool-use procedures. However, malicious instructions inserted into an otherwise benign skill can cause a benign user request to trigger dangerous Tool Calls, including data exfiltration, file deletion, or unauthorized code execution. This paper presents ActionGuard, which inspects skill-influenced Tool Calls immediately before execution. ActionGuard separates the target agent's action-generation context from the safeguard's authorization context. The target agent may use the original skill for planning, but the Reviewer does not receive the potentially poisoned raw skill text. Instead, it determines whether each action is justified by the trusted user request using a balanced skill profile, current and recent Tool Calls, and local script contents. ActionGuard intercepts each Tool Call at OpenClaw's before-tool-call stage and enforces the Reviewer's ALLOW or DENY decision under a fail-closed policy. We evaluate ActionGuard on 139 contextual and 180 obvious injections in a SKILL-INJECT-based setting against Dynamic Guardian and SkillGuard, using three open-source and two commercial Reviewer models. Each condition is repeated three times and evaluated using Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Task Success Rate (TSR). Overall, ActionGuard reduced ASR by 35.54 to 46.11 percent relative to existing safeguards and by 70.44 percent relative to No Safeguard, while maintaining high benign-task completion. These results show that execution-boundary authorization grounded in trusted user intent and runtime evidence can restrict unauthorized Tool Calls induced by skill injection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体通过第三方技能(skill)扩展能力,这些技能通常包含任务指令、脚本和工具调用流程。风险在于:即使一个技能本身看似良性,只要其中被植入少量恶意指令,一次完全正常的用户请求就可能被诱导成危险的工具调用,例如数据外泄、删除文件或执行未授权代码。现有防护的问题在于,智能体在规划时直接消费可能被污染的原始技能文本,安全检查与攻击面共享同一上下文,审查者容易被注入内容'说服'。论文提出 ActionGuard,一种在执行前对受技能影响的工具调用进行授权的机制。其核心设计是上下文隔离:目标智能体仍可使用原始技能进行规划,但作为审查者的 Reviewer 不会接收到可能被污染的原始技能文本,而是基于三方面可信证据判断每个动作是否被用户请求所正当化——一份平衡化的技能画像(balanced skill profile)、当前及近期工具调用记录、以及本地脚本内容。ActionGuard 在 OpenClaw 的 before-tool-call 阶段拦截每一次工具调用,并按 fail-closed(默认拒绝)策略强制执行 Reviewer 的 ALLOW/DENY 决策。实验在 SKILL-INJECT 设置下,覆盖 139 个上下文型注入与 180 个显性注入样本,与 Dynamic Guardian 和 SkillGuard 对比,使用 3 个开源与 2 个商用 Reviewer 模型,每种条件重复三次,以攻击成功率(ASR)与任务成功率(TSR)为评价指标。结果显示:相较现有防护方案,ASR 降低 35.54%至 46.11%;相较无防护(No Safeguard)降低 70.44%,同时良性任务完成率保持较高水平。研究结论表明,以可信用户意图与运行时证据为基础、部署在执行边界的授权机制,能够有效限制由技能注入引发的未授权工具调用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 技能/插件投毒是 LLM 智能体落地的核心风险面。该工作给出可落地的执行边界授权思路:隔离审查上下文、fail-closed 拦截,并附 ASR/TSR 量化对比,适合用于设计智能体运行时防护。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到任何支持第三方技能/插件/MCP 工具生态的智能体运行时(如编码助手、自动化运维 Agent、RPA 平台),用于在工具执行前做意图一致性校验;也可作为企业落地智能体时的准入与审计控制点参考。
detection_signals_zh: 工具调用与用户原始请求语义不一致,例如请求为读取/汇总却出现外发网络请求、删除操作或代码执行
单次会话内出现与任务无关的高权限工具调用序列(写文件、发起外联、执行脚本)
技能文本被更新后短期内该技能触发的工具调用种类或参数分布发生突变
Reviewer 频繁给出 DENY 决策,或同一技能的 DENY 率在版本变更后显著上升
本地脚本内容与其声明的技能功能不匹配,如文档类技能携带网络或进程操作逻辑
良性任务完成率(TSR)下降伴随拦截量上升,提示注入尝试或策略过严
defense_advice_zh: 在工具调用执行前部署独立授权层,审查上下文不得包含未经净化的原始技能文本
对审查器采用 fail-closed 默认拒绝策略,异常或无法判定时阻断而非放行
对工具实施最小权限与白名单,区分读写、外联、执行类能力并单独审批
维护技能的平衡化画像(声明能力与实际行为基线),技能版本变更后重新评估
完整记录工具调用链、审查决策与理由,纳入 SOC 告警与事后取证
以 ASR/TSR 双指标做上线前后回归,避免防护措施过度阻断正常业务

items.title: Can Agents Trust Their Skills? Uncovering Unsafe Chains of Trust in Skill-Based LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on installable skills, which are packages of instructions, code, and resources that equip them with task-specific capabilities and, once installed, can be automatically invoked across subsequent user tasks. This creates a chain of trust in which users delegate authority to agents, while agent frameworks admit skill-provided content into the agents' context with insufficient validation, allowing malicious skills to influence agent behavior under that delegated authority. Yet, little is known about whether this trust model adequately constrains untrusted skill content before it reaches security-sensitive operations, or how frequently such trust violations arise in real-world agents. We present TrustProbe, a framework for uncovering unsafe chains of trust in skill-based LLM agents. First, TrustProbe analyzes agent source code to identify source-to-sink call paths from skill-controlled inputs to security-sensitive operations. Second, it generates semantically realistic SKILL.md seeds with injected canaries and evolves them through feedback-guided scheduling and mutation. Finally, it validates vulnerabilities using an oracle that confirms attacker-controlled flows and verifies observable harm. Across 11 open-source agents, eight with more than 10,000 GitHub stars, TrustProbe identifies 104 taint-style vulnerabilities. Validation on a large corpus of real-world skills collected from public hubs such as ClawHub further shows that 25.1% of skill-agent trials exercise the identified vulnerable paths, with payload injection successfully weaponizing 15 of the vulnerabilities. These results reveal a systematic trust failure in skill-based LLM agents: untrusted skill content can reach security-sensitive operations and exercise authority delegated by users to their agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了基于「技能(Skill)」的可安装能力包给 LLM 智能体带来的信任链安全问题。当前 LLM 智能体生态中,技能以指令、代码与资源打包的形式分发,用户安装后,智能体框架会在后续任务中自动调用这些技能。这形成了三层信任传递:用户把权限委托给智能体,智能体框架把技能提供的内容直接注入上下文,而框架对技能内容的校验明显不足,于是恶意技能可以在用户已授予的权限范围内影响智能体行为。论文指出,目前尚不清楚这一信任模型是否能在不可信技能内容抵达安全敏感操作之前对其形成有效约束,也不清楚此类信任违背在真实智能体中有多普遍。为此作者提出 TrustProbe 框架,包含三个环节:第一,静态分析智能体源代码,识别从「技能可控输入」到「安全敏感操作」的 source-to-sink 污点调用路径;第二,生成语义上真实可信的 SKILL.md 种子文档,在其中注入金丝雀(canary)标记,再通过反馈引导的调度与变异策略持续演化这些种子;第三,使用判定器(oracle)验证漏洞,确认数据流确实由攻击者可控,并且能够造成可观测的危害。作者在 11 个开源智能体上进行了评估,其中 8 个在 GitHub 上拥有超过 1 万星标,共识别出 104 个污点式(taint-style)漏洞。作者还从 ClawHub 等公共技能仓库收集了大规模真实技能语料,验证显示 25.1% 的技能-智能体试验组合会触发已识别的脆弱路径,而载荷注入成功将其中 15 个漏洞实际「武器化」,即从潜在脆弱性变为可复现的真实危害。论文的结论是:基于技能的 LLM 智能体存在系统性的信任失效——不可信的技能内容能够抵达安全敏感操作,并在执行过程中行使用户委托给智能体的权限。该工作把软件安全中的污点分析与模糊测试思路系统性地迁移到了 LLM 智能体技能供应链场景,为智能体平台与技能市场的安全设计提供了可复用的检测方法论。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 技能市场正在成为 LLM 智能体的第三方供应链,但框架普遍默认信任已安装技能。论文在 11 个高星开源智能体中发现 104 个污点漏洞,并在真实技能语料中验证 25.1% 的尝试可触达脆弱路径,说明这是一类系统性、可规模化的问题,而非个别实现缺陷。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有支持可安装技能/插件/工具的智能体运行时与技能分发平台:一旦用户安装恶意或投毒技能,技能内容即可经由框架的自动调用获得用户已委托的权限。可用于评估企业内部自研智能体框架、第三方技能市场准入审核,以及智能体产品的上线前安全测试。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体执行过程中从技能可控输入(如 SKILL.md 指令文本、技能参数)到安全敏感操作(文件读写、命令执行、网络出站、凭证访问)的完整调用链
已安装技能中出现诱导性指令文本,试图改变智能体对后续任务的默认决策或扩大其权限使用范围
技能调用后出现与当前用户任务语义无关的外发网络请求、文件系统改动或进程创建行为
技能版本更新后新增未声明的能力、依赖或可执行片段,且与技能描述声称的功能不匹配
同一技能在多个不同用户任务中被自动触发并反复触达同一敏感操作路径
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体框架中引入技能内容与安全敏感操作之间的污点追踪与静态调用路径分析,作为 CI/发布门禁
对技能实施最小权限与能力声明机制(声明式权限清单),未声明的敏感操作默认拒绝
在沙箱或受限执行环境中运行技能派生代码,隔离文件系统、网络与凭证,并对越权访问做强拦截
对技能市场/内部技能库实行来源审核、签名与人工复核,重点审查 SKILL.md 中的指令性内容
记录并审计「技能安装—自动调用—敏感操作」的完整审计链,支持回溯与告警
把技能视为不可信第三方依赖,纳入既有软件供应链与漏洞管理流程
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进:将污点式技能信任链检测纳入内部智能体框架与技能市场的安全评估清单,并复现其检测思路用于自研智能体的上线前测试。

items.title: Pretext: Defeating Malicious Skill Detection Frameworks for AI Agents
items.summary: Skills extend an agent's capabilities by injecting instructions and information into the context, and are widely used by agents such as OpenClaw and Claude Code. Prior work shows third-party marketplaces host malicious skills that give attackers direct influence over the victim's agent. The emerging defense scans skills before installation, pairing deterministic static checks with an LLM-based semantic judge, as in NVIDIA's SkillSpector. We show that such defenses fall to an attacker who knows the detector. Our white-box LLM attacker, Pretext, iteratively crafts skills that evade detection while still delivering the payload and performing the benign task: moving the payload from code into natural language leaves static analysis inert, while framing it as the skill's legitimate purpose and splitting instructions across files keeps the LLM stage below its blocking threshold. Across three open-source models, Pretext achieves up to 97\% and 77\% against a frozen detector and a co-adaptive one, respectively, revealing major gaps in current skill scanners.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究 AI Agent(如 OpenClaw、Claude Code)技能(Skill)生态中的恶意技能检测问题。技能通过向 Agent 上下文注入指令与信息来扩展其能力,已成为 Agent 能力扩展的主流方式;已有研究表明第三方技能市场存在恶意技能,攻击者可借此直接影响受害者 Agent 的行为。为此出现了安装前扫描类防御,典型代表是 NVIDIA 的 SkillSpector:它将确定性静态检查与基于 LLM 的语义裁判组合使用,先用代码层规则匹配,再由大模型判断技能意图是否恶意。作者提出白盒 LLM 攻击方法 Pretext,假设攻击者了解检测器的实现,通过迭代式改写技能内容来同时满足两个目标:绕过检测,并仍然完成载荷投递与表面上的正常任务。其核心思路有三点:把载荷从可执行代码转移到自然语言指令,使依赖代码特征的静态分析失效;把恶意意图包装为技能自称的"合法用途",降低 LLM 语义裁判的怀疑度;把完整指令拆分到多个文件,使任何单文件片段都难以达到 LLM 阶段的阻断阈值。评估覆盖三个开源模型,Pretext 对冻结检测器的绕过率最高达 97%,对协同自适应(co-adaptive)检测器仍达 77%。论文结论是当前技能扫描器存在系统性缺口:单点、单文件、单模态的检测难以应对掌握检测器知识的自适应攻击者。该工作适合 Agent 平台安全团队、AI 供应链治理与检测工程方向的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 技能是 Agent 获取能力的主要入口,安装后即可直接影响 Agent 上下文。论文证明当前"静态规则 + LLM 语义裁判"的安装前扫描在了解检测器的攻击者面前可被系统性绕过(最高 97%),若企业把技能扫描当作唯一准入控制,将形成虚假安全感,需重新评估 Agent 供应链的信任模型。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用第三方或自建技能市场的 Agent 平台(Claude Code、OpenClaw 类)以及在其上构建的内部 Agent。可迁移到任何"文本即指令"的准入扫描场景:MCP 工具描述、浏览器/IDE 插件清单、提示词模板仓库、AI 代码助手配置等。
detection_signals_zh: 技能文件中出现自然语言形式的操作指令,与其声明的功能范围明显不匹配
技能目录内各文件单独看内容无害,但跨文件拼接后形成完整的指令链
技能元数据、描述文本与实际引用的工具、文件路径、网络目标不一致
同一技能在多次扫描之间内容频繁迭代微调,呈现针对检测器反馈的试探性变化
技能要求 Agent 忽略既有策略、扩大权限,或在安装后加载上下文中的外部内容
defense_advice_zh: 不要把安装前扫描作为唯一准入控制,叠加最小权限、沙箱化执行与安装后运行时监控
从单文件检测升级为跨文件、跨模态(代码 + 自然语言 + 元数据)联合分析,对技能做整体意图重建
避免使用长期冻结的检测器,引入对抗性训练与周期性红队评估,防止被针对固定版本调优的绕过手法击穿
对高风险技能设置人工复核、来源签名与版本差异比对机制
把技能视为不可信输入,限制其可触发的工具调用范围,并对执行结果做输出侧校验
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估

items.title: Autonomous OSS Threat Detection via Taxonomy-Aligned LLMs
items.summary: Open source software (OSS) ecosystems face growing threats from sophisticated supply chain attacks including typosquatting, dependency confusion, Trojan Source obfuscation, malicious build injection, and CI/CD pipeline poisoning. Existing detection approaches rely on signature-based tools and rule-based systems that struggle to generalize across attack variants and emerging threat patterns. In this paper we propose a taxonomy-aligned large language model framework for automated detection and classification of OSS supply chain threats. We introduce a structured AV-xxx threat taxonomy covering five attack categories and construct a curated dataset of 999 verified real-world OSS supply chain incidents sourced from GitHub Security Advisories, CISA alerts, and security research reports spanning 2018 to 2026. Using taxonomy-aligned prompt engineering with GPT-4, our framework achieves 97.0\% multi-class classification accuracy and 97.0\% macro F1 score across all five threat categories. Comparative evaluation against five traditional machine learning baselines, one zero-shot open source LLM, and two fine-tuned neural models reveals a surprising finding: fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (70.5%) and SecRoBERTa (77.5%) both underperform simple TF-IDF classifiers (82.3%), while Mistral 7B without taxonomy alignment achieves only 65.7%. These results confirm that taxonomy-aligned prompting rather than model scale, domain pretraining, or fine-tuning is the critical factor enabling high classification accuracy. Our dataset and code are publicly available to support reproducible supply chain security research.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 开源软件（OSS）生态系统面临日益复杂的供应链攻击，包括域名仿冒（typosquatting）、依赖混淆、Trojan Source 混淆、恶意构建注入以及 CI/CD 管道投毒。现有检测方法依赖签名和规则系统，难以泛化到攻击变种和新兴威胁模式。本文提出一种分类法对齐的大型语言模型（LLM）框架，用于自动化检测和分类 OSS 供应链威胁。作者引入结构化的 AV-xxx 威胁分类法，覆盖五类攻击，并构建了包含 999 个经过验证的真实 OSS 供应链事件的数据集，来源包括 GitHub 安全公告、CISA 警报和安全研究报告，时间跨度为 2018 年至 2026 年。使用分类法对齐的提示工程与 GPT-4，框架在五类威胁上达到 97.0% 的多分类准确率和 97.0% 的宏 F1 分数。与五个传统机器学习基线、一个零样本开源 LLM 和两个微调神经模型的对比评估揭示了一个令人惊讶的发现：微调的 Llama 3.1 8B（70.5%）和 SecRoBERTa（77.5%）均不如简单的 TF-IDF 分类器（82.3%），而未经分类法对齐的 Mistral 7B 仅达到 65.7%。这些结果证实，分类法对齐的提示工程，而非模型规模、领域预训练或微调，是实现高分类准确率的关键因素。数据集和代码已公开，以支持可重复的供应链安全研究。适合关注 OSS 供应链安全、LLM 应用和自动化威胁检测的研究人员与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为 OSS 供应链威胁检测提供了新思路：分类法对齐的提示工程可显著提升 LLM 检测准确率，且不依赖大模型或微调，对资源有限的防御团队有实用价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到企业 OSS 依赖审查、CI/CD 安全监控、软件成分分析（SCA）告警分类等场景，帮助安全团队自动化识别和归类供应链攻击。
detection_signals_zh: typosquatting：包名与知名库仅差一两个字符且发布者/下载量异常
dependency confusion：内部包名在公共仓库中出现同名包
Trojan Source：源代码中出现隐藏的 Unicode 双向控制字符
恶意构建注入：构建脚本（如 Makefile、package.json scripts）包含异常网络请求或编码命令
CI/CD 投毒：流水线配置文件被修改或引入外部未知 action
defense_advice_zh: 采用分类法对齐的提示工程来使用或训练 LLM 检测 OSS 供应链威胁
不要盲目追求大模型或领域微调，应重视结构化威胁分类法与提示设计
结合传统 TF-IDF 基线做对比，验证 LLM 检测方案的实际增益
建立并持续更新结构化 OSS 供应链威胁分类法，提升检测一致性与覆盖率
利用公开数据集和代码复现研究，评估在自身环境中的检测效果
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估将分类法对齐的提示工程引入内部 OSS 供应链检测流程

items.title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
items.summary: With the increasing capabilities of Large-Language-Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents, users are increasingly using them to solve everyday problems, such as answering e-mails or providing programming support. Existing work has extensively investigated security and privacy risks, such as prompt injections and the disclosure of sensitive data to chatbot providers. While various solutions were developed to address these risks, including input structuring to prevent prompt injections or deploying local LLMs to avoid sharing confidential data with chatbot operators, LLMs also pose the risk of leaking confidential data to third parties. In this paper, we demonstrate with LLMLeak a novel attack vector where malicious software that runs locally but cannot communicate directly with the internet abuses LLMs to establish a covert channel. While inputs that instruct the LLM to send data directly via generated code are easy to detect and network libraries are typically restricted, LLMLeak relies only on the LLM's tool to fetch websites for further information. A malicious software component on the client side embeds a secret into a URL. It presents the referenced website as providing information required for a benign task, such as migrating a software library. When the LLM accesses the URL, the attacker receives the encoded secret through an attacker-controlled DNS or web server. We perform an extensive evaluation on eleven open-parameter models, observe an attack success rate of 79.7%, and also conduct a case study on real-world chatbots, demonstrating the relevance of LLMLeak.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注 LLM 与 LLM Agent 在真实工作流中的安全与隐私风险。此前研究多聚焦于提示注入、以及用户数据被聊天机器人服务商获取等问题，并提出了输入结构化、本地部署模型等缓解手段。但作者指出一个被忽视的方向：机密数据可能经由 LLM 被泄露给第三方。论文提出并系统评估了一种新型攻击向量 LLMLeak：本地运行的恶意软件若不能直接联网，可以滥用 LLM 的网页抓取工具来建立隐蔽信道。与直接要求 LLM 生成代码发送数据这类容易被检测的做法不同，LLMLeak 只依赖 LLM 为获取额外信息而访问网页的工具能力。客户端恶意组件把待外泄的秘密编码进一个 URL，并以良性任务（例如迁移某个软件库）所需信息为借口，把该 URL 呈现给 LLM；当 LLM 访问该 URL 时，攻击者通过其控制的 DNS 或 Web 服务器接收编码后的秘密，从而完成外泄。作者在 11 个开放参数模型上做了广泛评估，观察到 79.7% 的攻击成功率，并在真实聊天机器人上进行了案例研究，表明该威胁具有现实相关性。论文的主要贡献在于：揭示 LLM 网页抓取工具可被用作隐蔽外泄通道；量化其在多模型上的有效性；说明仅靠输入结构化、禁用网络库或本地部署 LLM 等既有防护不足以覆盖该路径。适合 LLM 安全、Agent 安全、终端检测与数据防泄漏方向的研究者与安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 即使企业禁用模型代码执行、限制网络库或本地部署 LLM，端点上的恶意软件仍可借 LLM 的网页抓取工具把机密编码进 URL 外泄，绕过常见出口管控。这要求把 LLM 工具的网络出口纳入检测范围。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有允许 LLM/Agent 联网抓取网页的终端与企业环境，可迁移到邮件助手、IDE 编程助手、浏览器代理、客服 Agent 等具备 fetch 能力的场景。
detection_signals_zh: LLM 工具发起的对外网页请求出现与用户任务无关的冷门或新注册域名
URL 路径/子域中包含高熵、Base32/Base64 风格或超长随机字符串
来自 LLM Agent 进程的 DNS 查询指向异常子域或攻击者可控域名
同一会话中 LLM 抓取的 URL 与用户正常任务上下文明显不匹配
本地非网络权限进程与 LLM 之间的异常 IPC/输入注入行为
LLM 工具出口流量与终端 EDR 事件的时序关联异常
defense_advice_zh: 对 LLM/Agent 网页抓取工具实施出口代理与域名白名单，记录并审计所有 fetch URL 与 DNS 查询
对 URL 中的高熵片段和异常子域进行检测与告警
限制本地进程向 LLM 会话注入 URL 或工具调用的能力，对本地组件做沙箱与权限隔离
将会话日志、工具调用日志与网络出口日志做关联分析，识别跨层隐蔽信道
在红队/内部评估中加入 LLM 工具外泄路径的测试用例

items.title: Safety Must Survive Self-Improvement: Why Failures Persist and How Agents Recover
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) allows agents to carry useful changes across generations. Maintaining safety across these generations involves both preventing unsafe behavior from persisting and enabling recovery when failures occur. We study these challenges through a controlled testbed of stateful authorization tasks, where fixed LLM editors optimize executable agent components and independent traces record their effects. Paired interventions separate which revisions pass validation, which program continues running, and which program the editor revises next. After a new authorization dependency invalidates previously tested optimizations, historical scores preserve the same unsafe programs in 22 of 48 framework histories despite a correct alternative in every affected archive. Refreshing scores restores correctness on the original suite, with residual failures on independently composed tests. Failures also persist under an unchanged contract when all proposals are rejected and the failed incumbent remains active. Starting from shared failures, editing the initial implementation instead of the failed one improves recovery, although the advantage varies across editors. Full validation and validated rollback end with fully correct programs in the core trajectory study while retaining over 43% deployment savings. Preserving agent safety requires checking what will run under current conditions and choosing which implementation to edit next.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究递归自我改进（RSI）场景下智能体安全性的维持问题。所谓 RSI，是指智能体可以把自身的有用改动跨"代"传递下去，从而不断演化。作者指出，让安全在这种跨代演化中存活，包含两个必须同时解决的挑战：一是防止不安全行为在代际之间持续存留，二是当失败发生时能够真正恢复。为在可控条件下研究这两点，作者构建了一个有状态授权任务的测试床：由固定的 LLM 编辑器去优化可执行的智能体组件，同时用相互独立的追踪记录来观测这些改动产生的实际效果。作者设计了一组"配对干预"，把通常被混在一起讨论的三个环节拆开：哪些修订能够通过验证、哪一个程序被继续运行、以及编辑器下一次去修订哪一个程序。核心实验结论是：当一个新的授权依赖出现、使此前已经测试过的优化方案失效时，历史分数会把同样不安全的程序继续保留下来——在 48 条框架历史中有 22 条如此，尽管每一条受影响的历史存档中都存在一个正确的替代实现。如果刷新分数重新评估，原始测试套件上的正确性可以恢复，但在独立组合出来的测试上仍会存在残余失败。作者还发现，在合约完全不变的情况下，如果所有提案都被拒绝、失败的现任实现继续处于活跃状态，失败同样会持续存在。进一步实验显示，从共同的失败状态出发，去编辑"初始实现"而不是"已经失败的那个实现"，可以提升恢复效果，但这种优势在不同编辑器之间并不稳定。最后，完整验证配合经过验证的回滚，在核心轨迹研究中能收敛到完全正确的程序，同时仍保留超过 43% 的部署成本节省。作者的总结是：保持智能体安全，必须检查在当前条件下实际将要运行的是什么，并谨慎选择下一步去编辑哪个实现。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动化/自主迭代的智能体流水线中，安全属性可能被"陈旧分数"和"陈旧存档"锁死：合约或依赖一变，历史最优解可能已不安全却仍被执行。该工作把失败机理拆成验证、运行、下一步编辑三环节，并给出验证与回滚的可操作设计原则，对做 LLM 智能体持续集成与安全门禁的团队有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 LLM 驱动的自动化代码与策略自优化流水线、智能体持续集成/持续部署、授权与策略引擎的版本管理、提示词与模型自动迭代的回归门禁，以及任何依赖"历史评分选优"的自主系统。
detection_signals_zh: 候选实现的评分长期未随合约、依赖或授权策略变更而刷新
同一存档中并存"历史高分但不安全"与"分数较低但正确"的实现
验证通过清单与最终实际运行的程序不一致
缺少经过验证的回滚路径，失败实现被拒绝提案后仍处于活跃状态
提案反复被拒但现任失败实现长期未替换
defense_advice_zh: 在合约/授权依赖变更时强制触发历史候选的重算分与重新验证，禁止直接沿用历史分
对将要部署或运行的实例做全量验证，而不是信任存档中的历史得分
为每次自动改进配置经过验证的回滚点，确保失败实现可被安全替换
分别对"通过验证的修订"
继续运行的程序
下一个被编辑的实现
三个环节埋点与审计
在恢复策略上考虑编辑初始实现或引入存档多样性，避免持续锁定在失败实现上
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：纳入内部智能体自优化与安全门禁的评估设计，可将"分数刷新 + 全量验证 + 经验证回滚"作为基线控制项试点。
